title: Lab 04: Software Repair Agent Experiment Report

sections.title: 1. Case and Objective
sections.placeholder: Identify the software service, the three defects and what the agent comparison measures. State the expected behaviour of one selected function.

sections.title: 2. Agent Implementations
sections.placeholder: Explain your select_context, reactive_agent and intelligent_agent functions. Include the key code and one example of each agent's decision on failed tests.

sections.title: 3. Experimental Procedure
sections.placeholder: Describe the identical starting TypeScript source, Gemini model, fixed initial prompts, compiler and regression suite. Explain the one-attempt reactive policy and the intelligent agent's three-attempt limit. State how repetitions and excluded API failures were handled.

sections.title: 4. Measured Results
sections.placeholder: Include the overall table and per-issue breakdown for checkout, queue and security. Report completed trial counts, successful fixes, mean end-to-end time, worker JSON messages/bytes, model calls and model tokens. Use at least two figures generated from your observed CSV records. List excluded API or execution errors separately.

sections.title: 5. Failure Analysis and Comparison
sections.placeholder: Explain which defects and repetitions were evaluated, any API errors, and whether a second or third patch was needed. If both agents achieved 100% first-attempt success, identify the ceiling effect and compare time/model/worker costs instead of claiming an unsupported performance benefit. Include one actual patch or diagnostic from the traces.

sections.title: 6. Conclusion
sections.placeholder: Summarise what was observed, not presumed. State one limitation of the sample size or variability and one improvement to the agent.
